item.title: Real-Time Chinese Ink Rendering for VR
item.description: ROLE Project Lead & Technical Artist YEAR 2022 ENGINE Unity TECH ShaderLab / HLSL, Unity XR PLATFORM Oculus Rift S FOCUS Stylized Rendering, Shader Development, VR Integration RESPONSIBILITY Led the project’s visual and technical direction, developing the real-time Chinese ink rendering system for characters and environments. Designed and implemented custom shaders, VR interaction, and spatial UI in Unity, integrating them into a complete three-scene VR experience. Profiled and optimized the final experience for Oculus Rift S, averaging 89.

item.title: UE5 Animation - Harvest Day
item.description: ROLE Independent YEAR 2023 TOOLS USED Unreal Engine 5, DaVinci Resolve GENRE Cinematic RESPONSIBILITY Conduct preliminary research, and write scripts and storyboards. Use Quixel Bridge and marketplace kits to build scenes; create materials, animations, visual effects, etc. for the environment. Perform facial motion capture for MetaHuman characters; adjust camera animation. Edit the footage, and add music and sound effects. DESCRIPTION This project is a 3D animated short film made in Unreal Engine 5.

item.title: Robi - AI-Powered XR Host at Signals by DigiBC and VIFF
item.description: ROLE Technical Artist, Developer YEAR 2024 TOOLS USED Unity GENRE Web RESPONSIBILITY Collaborated to develop an engaging virtual host solution for the SIGNALS event, showcasing AI and MR technology Directed 3D pipeline management; facilitated team communication with 3D artist and developers Used profiler tools to analyze optimization bottlenecks, reducing shader variants and texture size, achieving an 11% reduction in memory usage Implemented the AR solution using Unity WebGL and Web AR; conducted stress tests and created technical documentation DESCRIPTION

item.title: SandScape - A Digital Sandtray Therapy for Kids by BC Children's Hospital
item.description: ROLE Technical Artist YEAR 2024 TOOLS USED Unity GENRE Web RESPONSIBILITY Led the integration and optimization of 8 environments and 132 separate 3D assets (miniatures), working closely with the 3D artist and developers to ensure seamless Unity deployment. Developed and implemented custom shaders, post-processing, and VFX to enhance visual engagement and immersion DESCRIPTION SandScape is an industrial collaboration with BC Children's Hospital Digital Lab, aimed at developing a digital therapeutic tool for kids.
